facts.text: John and his partner had a wedding ceremony at a greenhouse venue that was described as lovely and intimate.

evidence.quote: We were lucky to find a lovely greenhouse venue for a smaller, more intimate gathering.
It sounds like you found a great venue and had your loved ones celebrate with you.

facts.text: John mentioned that some of his hiking club friends attended the wedding despite him having recently joined the club.

evidence.quote: Some of my hiking club friends came even though I just joined!

facts.text: John described a memorable moment from his wedding day as seeing his partner walking down the aisle, which made him emotional.

evidence.quote: Seeing her walking down the aisle, her face lit up and it got me all choked up.

facts.text: John and his partner had their first dance at a cozy restaurant with music and candlelight.

evidence.quote: We had our first dance at a cozy restaurant. It was so dreamy with the music and candlelight.
